name: zenborg-gesture-glyphs
paddingRationale: ~1/phi^2 of a cell; the canvas-level 38.2% margin in the grammar table is unworkable at icon scale

meaning.plant: the seed over its ground (the grammar's Plan mark)
meaning.cultivate: the seed held off-centre in a field of attention (Cultivate mark, crosshair dropped: it read as a target)
meaning.harvest: the ground curved into a bowl that holds the seed (the grammar's harvesting operation applied to Plant; the S-curve version read as yin-yang)
meaning.fence: a boundary around the seed with a gap: a timed fence, the gate opens (lives under Cultivate)
meaning.fence-standing: the boundary closed: a standing fence
meaning.fence-gate: the seed in the gateway: a pause gate you pass through
meaning.phase-morning: seed low and left of its ground
meaning.phase-evening: seed low and right of its ground

rule: Every mark carries the same seed point; only the ground around it changes. Phases are the seed's position relative to its ground over the day.
defaultsOnly: Phase glyphs are the default when a phase has no user emoji. Phase emoji are user-owned (Settings) and stay.
